state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

policy.name: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) - 2022, U.T. of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu (as amended by Circular No. DIC/5(514)/2020/2025-26/125 dated 19-08-2026, effective 01-04-2026)

schemes.name: A.1 Fixed Capital Investment Subsidy (MSME)
schemes.notes: 15% of Gross Fixed Capital Investment (building, P&M, utilities, tools; excludes land). An extra Rs 10 lakh if eligible GFCI is over Rs 10 crore. First-generation women and differently abled entrepreneurs setting up new units get +10% of GFCI, up to Rs 15 lakh. Covers new units and one expansion/diversification (>=50% increase in GFCI, >=60% of it in P&M). The 19-08-2026 amendment requires a 5-year gap between a new unit and its expansion. A bank/FI term loan is required (no NBFC), sanctioned within 1 year of commercial production; apply within 1 year. UT + central capital subsidy combined is capped at 35% of GFCI. Only new assets qualify. Must keep producing for 5 years.

schemes.name: A.2 Interest Subsidy (MSME manufacturing)

benefit.rate_rule: from 01-04-2026: 50% of the bank interest rate if the rate is <=10%; capped at 5 percentage points if the rate is >10%

schemes.clause: Scheme A.2, para A.2.3 (Gazette p.13), amended by Circular dated 19-08-2026 item 1
schemes.notes: Originally 50% of interest charged, up to Rs 30 lakh/yr, for 5 years or the repayment period, whichever is earlier. From 01-04-2026: 50% of the rate if <=10%, max 5% if >10%. 'rate' 0.05 is the max percentage points; use rate_rule. Women, differently abled and registered startups get +10% extra subsidy, and entrepreneurs under 35 get +10% (A.2.3(2)-(3)). How the +10% combines with the amended rate is unclear. The unit must bear at least 2% interest. Covers term loans on new machinery, equipment, building, furniture (not land). Paid directly to the bank.

schemes.name: A.3 Assistance for Quality Certification
schemes.notes: 50% of certification fees (BIS, ISI, WHO, GMP, Hallmark, etc.) plus 50% of testing equipment needed for certification, up to Rs 10 lakh in total. Certifier must be NABCB-registered. Statutory certifications and renewals are excluded. Apply within 1 year of the certificate.

schemes.name: A.5 Assistance for ZED Certification
schemes.notes: 50% of ZED charges net of GoI assistance, up to Rs 1,00,000. New and existing units. Apply within 1 year of the certificate.

schemes.name: A.11 Capital subsidy for Solar Power Generation
schemes.notes: 25% of solar plant capital cost, up to Rs 50 lakh, available once. Solar must meet >=10% of the unit's power consumption. Paid at the prevailing UT SoR rates for panels. Apply within 6 months of generation.

schemes.name: D.2 Environment Protection Infrastructure Subsidy (ZLD/ETP/HW)
schemes.notes: 25% of capital cost of ZLD / effluent treatment / hazardous waste TSDF / single-use-plastic alternative facilities, up to Rs 30 lakh. Only where PCC has not mandated ZLD. All industrial units.

other_benefits: A.4 Patent/Trade Mark registration: 75% of cost up to Rs 25 lakh per applicant
A.6 Energy/water audit 75% up to Rs 1 lakh; recommended equipment 25% up to Rs 20 lakh (min 20% saving)
A.7 Skill/entrepreneurship training: 75% of course fee up to Rs 1.5 lakh/course, up to 20 persons/yr
A.8 SME Exchange listing: 25% of expenses up to Rs 5 lakh
A.9 Export doubling: 1% of export value up to Rs 20 lakh (women: 2% up to Rs 30 lakh)
A.10 FOB reimbursement (food/marine exports): 20% of FOB up to Rs 20 lakh/yr for 3 years
A.12 Exhibitions abroad: 50% of space rent up to Rs 2 lakh
A.13 Local employment: Rs 3 lakh per 20 local recruits, max Rs 15 lakh
B.1 Textile sector interest subsidy: 60% of interest up to Rs 60 lakh/yr for 5 years (+10% for export carpet, up to Rs 70 lakh)

C.1-C.6 Thrust sectors (furniture, marble, IT/ITeS, EV, toys, semiconductors, medical equipment/AYUSH, food processing, marine, vaccines): enhanced capital/interest subsidies; furniture also gets a Re 1/unit power incentive for 1 year up to Rs 50 lakh (C.1.1(6))
D.1 Stamp duty reimbursement: 50% for MSMEs on land purchase (100% for thrust-sector industrial complexes)
unverifiable: No UT SGST-reimbursement, electricity duty or general per-unit power subsidy exists for MSMEs in IPS-2022 (only the furniture thrust-sector power incentive).
Whether the +10% interest top-ups for women, startups and young entrepreneurs still stack after the 01-04-2026 amendment is not stated.
